exposure.needed: whether ACME HTTP-01 challenges are solved against IPv6 endpoints at runtime

consequence.statement: After the upgrade, the ACME HTTP-01 solver handles IPv6 endpoints differently because of a bug fix. The release note does not describe the earlier failure or the new behaviour.

assertion.statement: cert-manager 1.17.0 fixes how the ACME HTTP-01 solver handles IPv6 endpoints (#7391).
